svg.title: Phylogenetic data faces (synthetic)
svg.desc: A karyon sheet of 4 panels in 2 columns: panel A, Bubble area encodes abundance while leaf bars retain exact host composition; panel B, Internal donuts and a clade sector keep ancestral uncertainty in context; panel C, Alignment rows follow descent without losing residues or unmatched samples; panel D, Domain gains and losses become blocks justified by the adjacent tree.

panel B, Internal donuts and a clade sector keep ancestral uncertainty in context
